I'll be making the final call on whether and how this moves forward, but per our usual practice, I want to hear from affected employees before we finalize the schedule and format. The main open questions are: office vs. off-site venue, and whether to go with Leah as our internal facilitator or bring in Dana as an external consultant. I'd love to get your thoughts and preferences on both.
